Diagnosis.Molecular Markers: ER+ (80-90%), PR+ (80-90%), HER2 by IHC & FISH negative, Ki67% 20-30%

Additional Comments: The patient, a 36-year-old female, has a hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative, node-positive right breast cancer. Recent imaging and biopsy results indicate a 2.2 cm mass in the upper central right breast with a 0.4 cm anterior satellite lesion, and prominent right axillary lymph nodes. A PET/CT scan revealed a hypermetabolic right breast mass and an enlarged right axillary lymph node, with additional subcentimeter, asymmetric right subpectoral lymph nodes showing low-level uptake. A 0.7 cm hyperdense falx lesion was identified, which could be a partially calcified falcine meningioma or dural metastasis, but an MRI brain scan suggested it is most likely a meningioma. The patient has undergone an egg harvest resulting in three fertilized embryos and is considering another round of egg harvesting post-surgery. She is scheduled for a partial mastectomy and axillary lymph node dissection on 11/05/17 and is planning subsequent adjuvant chemotherapy and hormonal therapy.
